description: Boil the perfect egg — soft (6 min), medium (8 min) and hard (10 min) presets plus a custom timer with alarm.

faqs.a: Soft 6 minutes (runny yolk), medium 8 minutes (jammy yolk), hard 10 minutes (fully set). Times assume large eggs lowered into already-boiling water.
Yes — enter any custom time from 1 to 60 minutes.
faqs.q: Can I set a custom time?

faqs.a: Move the eggs to ice water immediately for 5 minutes — this stops the cooking and makes peeling easier.
faqs.q: How do I stop the eggs overcooking?

howto: Pick soft, medium or hard — or set a custom time.
Lower your eggs into boiling water and press Start.
Wait for the alarm when the countdown ends.
Cool the eggs in ice water and peel.
title: Egg Timer
